summary: Index terminal ETA candidates and fold new terminal runs without rebuilding windows

replay.detail: Normal terminal transitions fold only the new run. Corrections and deletions refill affected windows through an indexed newest-64 terminal-run selection before selected-attempt execution claims are loaded.

schema.detail: Add the member-local rebuildable local_run_eta_terminal metadata projection with ordered definition-hash/terminal-time/run-id and run-id indexes. A one-time version-4 sample migration backfills terminal metadata; a distinct run_eta_triggers_v4 revision installs the exact current trigger layout even when an earlier v3 sample marker exists, without changing the schema cookie on subsequent opens.

rules.detail: Unusable terminal candidates still consume the 64-run bound. Existing selected-attempt durations, person-held exclusion, quartiles and true sample counts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The integer Unix-ms ETA publication cut and public wire shape are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The additive local projection initializes during normal store opening.

recovery.detail: Rollback leaves the local projection unused; original claims and shared projections are unchanged.
